title: Smt. Aneeta Rawat v. Sri Mahendra Prasad, Executive Engineer
disposition: Contempt disposed; further time to comply with Annexure 4.2 connection direction
headnote: On a civil contempt of a 2019 writ directing the Executive Engineer to consider grant of an electric connection in accordance with Annexure 4.2 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and not to insist on a no-objection certificate if an indemnity bond would serve, the Court recorded a prima facie case, gave three weeks more to comply, and disposed of the application with liberty to file afresh if the writ remained uncomplied. The connection itself was not decided.
facts: Smt. Aneeta Rawat obtained a 9 July 2019 writ directing the Executive Engineer to consider her electric-connection request under Annexure 4.2 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and not to insist on a no-objection certificate if an indemnity bond would suffice, her husband appearing to be the natural heir of the house owner, late Daya Ram. She alleged that, though a certified copy was submitted, Executive Engineer Sri Mahendra Prasad wilfully failed to comply, and sought punishment under section 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.

holding_units.holding: A prima facie case of civil contempt of the 9 July 2019 writ—directing the Executive Engineer to consider grant of electric connection in accordance with Annexure 4.2 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and not to insist on a no-objection certificate if an indemnity bond would serve—was made out. One further opportunity was given to comply within three weeks, and the contempt application was disposed of at this stage with liberty to move afresh if the writ remained uncomplied.

principle_tags.application: The writ now enforced in contempt had directed the Executive Engineer to consider grant of connection in accordance with Annexure 4.2 and, if necessary, not to insist on a no-objection certificate if an indemnity bond would suffice.

not_decided.point: Whether the electric connection should actually be granted
not_decided.note: The Court did not decide the connection on merits; it only directed further compliance with the prior consider-in-accordance-with-Annexure-4.2 order.

not_decided.point: Whether wilful contempt was established so as to punish the Executive Engineer
not_decided.note: Only a prima facie case was recorded; one more opportunity to comply was given and the application was disposed of at this stage.
